newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts trade in Delta.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts trade in Delta.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said trading in shares of Delta Electronics (Thailand) Plc would be halted in the morning session on Tuesday.
The SET said it was waiting for some undisclosed information from the company.
The halt in trading followed a local newspaper report that some of the firm's employees had protested on Monday against a new welfare scheme launched by the company.
A Delta official told Reuters the company's employees had protested in front of its factory in the eastern Samut Prakan province since Monday afternoon.
"About 1,000 workers held a protest in front of the factory. They were dissatisfied with the company's new welfare scheme," he said.
The firm's production line was completely stopped as all other workers had joined the protest and were on strike.
Delta is the manufacturer of electronic chips maker and majority owned by Taiwanese investors.
